{{Quote|The heart of Chiss politics lies on Csilla, and in the four ruling families. At the House Palace in Csilla's capital city of Csaplar can be found the Cabinet and Parliament.|Sentientologist Tem Eliss, ''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life''|<ref name="TC" />}}
The '''Cabinet''' was a ruling<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|154|Csaplar}}</ref> body of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. Its primary function was to serve as the executive counter to the [[Chiss Senate]]. The Cabinet was headquartered in the [[House Palace]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Csaplar/Legends|Csaplar]] on the Ascendancy's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]. Arranged beneath the four [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]&mdash;[[Csapla family|Csapla]], [[Nuruodo family|Nuruodo]], [[Inrokini family|Inrokini]], and [[Sabosen family|Sabosen]]&mdash;the Cabinet handled much of the governing of the Ascendancy, though all decisions of the ruling body were approved by one of the Families. Cabinet positions were appointed by the most relevant Ruling Family.<ref name="TC" />

Each [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] was responsible for specific areas of concern: Csapla handled [[Colonist/Legends|colonial]] affairs, resource distribution, and agriculture; Nuruodo handled the military and foreign affairs; Inrokini handled industry, science, and communication; and Sabosen handled justice, health, and education.<ref name="TC" /> The issues discussed in the Chiss Senate would be deferred to the departments in the Cabinet, which in turn would pass important matters to the Ruling Families.<ref name="FF">{{FFCite|137|CHI 1-4|Chiss}}</ref> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|5|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Chiss}}, which is presented as an entry in an [[in-universe]] [[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life|guide]], mentions the [[Battle of Garqi]], which is depicted in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''. The events of ''Dark Tide II: Ruin'' take place in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', meaning the entry must have been written by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the Cabinet was described in ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]'', a [[Book/Legends|book]] published by the [[University of Sanbra]] and written by the [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]].<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cabinet was first mentioned in the article "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Chiss]]," which was written by [[Juan Schwartz]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in the [[Star Wars Gamer 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="TC" /> on [[July 24]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010627.html|text=''Gamer'' #5. A Domain of Evil it is.}}</ref>
